page.layout: No printed text on this side. Only show-through from the reverse side, which is mirrored and faint, is visible.
page.notes: The page carries no printed text of its own. The large mirrored lines (EVANGELIO, AETERNO, and smaller lines beneath them, with a block of lines lower down and a short group at the foot) are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. The dark numeral "32." at the top left corner looks like a handwritten folio mark, not printed text, so it is left out. The scan is also dim, with a shadow at the right and bottom edges, which is not text.
